name: Humpty
source:
Guardian of the Mad Hatter's mansion.
Even though he doesn't look it, he's Dumpty's twin brother.
Their known as the Mad Eggs, or Mad Twins.
A narcissist who loves himself. He loves other beautiful things too, but he always puts himself first.
When he isn't seen as number one he gets mad and starts wildly firing his gun.
